title: Popular (Wicked)- Animation Exercise- VivziePop
author: Vivziepop
description:
Animation Acting exercise! I always imagined the acting in this song intro a very certain way, so I decided to animate it out!

The character animated is Villa, who is a secondary character planned for my "Hazbin Hotel" project! Animation took about a week of solid work!

 Crymini (the second character) is more a placement character in this
animation, as after tackling Villa I didn't have the energy to animate her as smoothly, and I didn't want her to be too distracting from Villa!

The song is "Popular" From the musical Wicked!

VivziePop is an independent animator, graduated from SVA in NYC!
I am a huge fan of musicals, and animating colorful and unique characters! When I'm not animating, i'm working on a number of other art related projects including a webcomic entitled "Zoophobia" where most of my animated characters come from!  I hope you enjoy my silly style of animation or art!
